fieldDescription: Manage this mod through an intel screen entry instead of its own Management bar button (for mod compatibility). If you don't see the manage button at the bottom, try turning this on. Takes effect on the next game load.

Press Escape while picking a key to clear it. A key the game already uses outside of combat is ignored. Other mods may have this setting, and if more than one is changed, the first in the Manage tab row wins. Takes effect on the next game load.
How many research points you gain each time a Liminal event stage completes. Not retroactive. You may also want to change the Crisis RP Begins At setting.
Multiplier on how many OP of Instructions you can fit inside templates.

How many OP of Instructions every Liminal Template can fit, instead of its normal amount. Set to 0 to disable. The post-crisis bonus and the Template OP Multiplier still apply, and the RP cost of unlocking a template scales with it. The template hullmod's own OP cost when fitted to a ship is unaffected.
Capacity each Liminal Template starts with. A frigate uses 2, a destroyer 3, a cruiser 4 and a capital ship 5.
Total credits to raise a template from its starting capacity to 5, enough for one capital ship.
Each further 5 capacity costs this many times as much as the 5 before.
In a Survival Mode game, template capacity, research investment and the entry fee cost half as many credits. Turn this off to keep the normal prices.
Meet the Liminal researchers at any market you dock at, not only at the Galatia Academy. The entry fee stays the same, and the boss fight still happens at the Academy.
Whether the Liminal super endgame crisis is enabled.
The crisis begins once your Total RP reaches this number.

Crisis difficulty. Higher difficulties are more computationally intensive, and the highest needs a good computer. Recommendations:
- Easy: Vanilla
- Standard: 50-100 balanced mods
- Hard: 200+ unbalanced mods

Chance for each ship in a non-Liminal NPC fleet to gain a Liminal Connection hullmod when you encounter that fleet, once the crisis has begun. Before then the chance is 25%% of this value once Total RP is halfway to the crisis, and 50%% at three quarters of the way. Does not affect the Liminal faction's own fleets. WARNING: raising this means many more Liminality-influenced ships in battles, and they are recoverable afterwards.

[Restart the game after changing] How computationally intensive the final boss is. Lower numbers will decrease the scale of the boss, but the overall difficulty will be the same or slightly higher. Values above 0.5 are not recommended.
